world.title: Satellite images show destruction from Nepal-Tibet floods
world.summary: A glacier collapse in the Himalayas triggered severe flooding along the Nepal-Tibet border, resulting in at least 359 confirmed deaths and over 1,300 people reported missing in Nepal and Tibet. The disaster unleashed a torrent of water, mud, and rock, devastating border towns and valleys. Rescue operations are ongoing as teams search for survivors in the affected areas.

world.title: Tourists carved names into around 350 bamboo stalks in Kyoto’s Arashiyama grove; the damage cannot be repaired, so officials began cutting bamboo and moving the grove beyond visitors’ reach
world.summary: Tourists have damaged approximately 350 bamboo stalks in Kyoto's Arashiyama Bamboo Grove by carving names and other writings into them. This vandalism has led officials to determine that the damage is irreparable. As a response, they have begun cutting the affected bamboo and relocating the grove to a site that is less accessible to visitors.

world.title: Russian military lieutenant colonel killed in St Petersburg car blast, wife injured
world.summary: A Russian military lieutenant colonel was killed in a car explosion in St Petersburg on Thursday morning. The blast occurred around 10 am local time near a supermarket in the Shushary neighborhood. His wife, who was in the vehicle, sustained serious injuries. Authorities are investigating the incident, but further details regarding the cause of the explosion remain unclear.

business.title: ‘Don’t taunt me as a billionaire’: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw on Karnataka MLA’s remark on her tweet about poor roads
business.summary: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw, founder of Biocon, criticized the poor road conditions in Anekal, Bengaluru, prompting a response from Karnataka Congress MLA B Shivanna. In her reply, Mazumdar-Shaw urged Shivanna not to mock her status as a billionaire, emphasizing that her concerns were on behalf of citizens affected by the inadequate infrastructure. The exchange highlights ongoing issues with local road conditions.

business.title: CAS effect? This Bankex Put option jumped from Rs 6 to Rs 1,000 within minutes
business.summary: On August 27, the Bankex 65,000 Put option surged from Rs 6 to Rs 1,000 within minutes during the monthly expiry day. This dramatic increase occurred as the Sensex indicated a significant 3.3% decline during the closing auction session. The rapid change left traders surprised, highlighting the volatility and unpredictability of market movements on expiry days.

business.title: India to develop 7nm to 3nm chip tech within 8 years: IT minister Ashwini Vaishnaw
business.summary: India aims to develop advanced 7nm to 3nm chip technology within eight years, according to IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw. The initiative includes expanding semiconductor manufacturing, research, advanced packaging, and chip-design capabilities. This marks a significant step in India's efforts to enhance its domestic silicon chip production and reduce reliance on foreign technology in the semiconductor sector.

technology.title: How to Upgrade to The Witcher 3 Remastered for Free
technology.summary: CD Projekt Red announced at Gamescom Opening Night Live that The Witcher 3 Remastered will be released on September 29. The remastered version will be available as a free upgrade for all current owners of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, or PC, including those who own the game on PS4 or Xbox One.

technology.title: Samsung Odyssey G6 hits 1,100Hz refresh rate at Gamescom
technology.summary: Samsung unveiled its 2027 Odyssey gaming monitor lineup at Gamescom 2026 in Cologne, Germany. The highlight is the 27-inch Odyssey G6 monitor, which features an impressive 1,100Hz refresh rate. Additionally, the lineup includes new OLED models. The Odyssey G6 was initially presented in December, and its specifications have been enhanced since then.

technology.title: Qualcomm’s upcoming Snapdragon mobile chip to be fastest in its class
technology.summary: Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chipset is set to be the fastest in its class, reaching a CPU speed of 5GHz. It features the Oryon CPU and FlexCache, enhancing gaming and AI performance. The official launch is scheduled for the 2026 Snapdragon Summit, where more details about its capabilities and specifications will be revealed.

sports.title: Unyielding Dinusha, spirited tail hold off India to save Colombo Test
sports.summary: Sonal Dinusha's unbeaten 133 helped Sri Lanka save the second Test against India in Colombo. After being asked to follow-on, Dinusha displayed remarkable resilience over seven hours, ensuring that India did not bat a second time. Supported by the lower order, his performance was crucial in securing a draw for Sri Lanka in this tightly contested match.

sports.title: Updated WTC Points Table after India vs Sri Lanka 2nd Test: Where does Gautam Gambhir's side stand?
sports.summary: India and Sri Lanka drew the second Test at Colombo's Sinhalese Sports Club, concluding the two-match series with India winning 1-0. The match saw India in a strong position before the draw was declared. Following this result, the updated World Test Championship points table reflects India's standing under head coach Gautam Gambhir, highlighting their performance in the series.

sports.title: Colombo Test: Doughty Dinusha thwarts India’s victory bid
sports.summary: Sri Lanka's Dinusha and Nuwantha formed a resilient partnership, helping their team reach 329 for six on Day 5 of the Colombo Test against India. Their efforts thwarted India's bid for victory, showcasing the unpredictable nature of Test cricket, which can result in draws rather than definitive outcomes, contrasting with the immediate results often seen in limited overs formats.

health.title: Killing mosquitoes- with technology sprays like TinyML, CNN and acoustic sensing
health.summary: Technological advancements are being utilized to combat mosquitoes, leveraging methods like TinyML, sensor intelligence, and acoustic sensing. These innovations analyze mosquito wing beats to develop effective control strategies. August 20 marks 'World Mosquito Day,' coinciding with the World Mosquito Program's observance of 'World Mosquito Week,' highlighting the significant impact of mosquito-borne diseases, which claim over one million lives annually.

health.title: African Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine candidate to be advanced to clinical trials
health.summary: CEPI has announced support for Minapharm's Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine candidate, which utilizes ProBioGen's proprietary MVA-CR19 platform. This advancement will lead the vaccine into clinical trials, marking a significant step in the development of a potential vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola. The collaboration highlights efforts to enhance vaccine research and development in Africa.

health.title: Beyond the robot: Why surgeon expertise still determines the success of robotic surgery
health.summary: Robotic surgical systems enhance visibility, instrument movement, and control compared to traditional tools. However, they cannot replace the essential surgical judgment of the surgeon. The success of robotic surgery ultimately depends on the surgeon's expertise in making critical decisions regarding dissection, preservation, and navigating complex anatomy. Human skill remains vital in achieving optimal surgical outcomes despite technological advancements.

science.title: 10 incredible Milky Way photos from NASA that look almost too beautiful to be real
science.summary: NASA has released a collection of ten stunning images of the Milky Way, highlighting its beauty and complexity. The photographs feature vibrant star fields, luminous nebulae, and impressive cosmic structures. Each image showcases the breathtaking aspects of our galaxy, providing a captivating visual experience that emphasizes the intricate details and grandeur of the Milky Way.

science.title: Partial lunar eclipse Aug. 27-28 live updates - tonight is the night!
science.summary: A deep partial lunar eclipse will occur on the night of August 27-28, with up to 96.2% of the lunar surface obscured. Live coverage will provide countdown updates, viewing tips, and real-time information throughout the event. This eclipse coincides with the full Sturgeon Moon, offering a significant astronomical experience for observers. Don't miss this celestial event.

science.title: 55 million-year-old penguin fossils reveal hidden chemical clues about Antarctica before the continent became frozen
science.summary: Fossils of 55 million-year-old penguins reveal that ancient Antarctica had warm, humid coastlines, contrasting sharply with its current icy state. Researchers utilized micro-X-ray fluorescence elemental mapping to analyze these fossils, providing insights into past weathering and climate change. This study enhances understanding of Antarctica's climatic history before it transformed into the frozen landscape observed today.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Tomorrow, August 28, 2026: A pause could give you the clarity and energy you need to move forward
entertainment.summary: On August 28, 2026, horoscopes suggest that a pause may provide clarity and energy for moving forward. While situations may test patience, individuals are advised against confrontation. Staying composed and trusting one's ability to handle pressure is emphasized. Restraint is highlighted as a more powerful response than forceful actions, especially when feeling worn out from repeated challenges.

entertainment.title: Shweta Tiwari says man who was abusing her online was not MNS worker, thanks Raj Thackeray for swift action
entertainment.summary: Shweta Tiwari addressed online abuse she faced, clarifying that the individual responsible was not affiliated with the Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS). She expressed gratitude to Raj Thackeray for his prompt response to the situation. Tiwari highlighted the growing issue of online harassment directed at women, sharing screenshots of the abusive messages she received on Instagram from various users.

entertainment.title: Ramayana: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash starrer 'Ramayana’ earns praise as 15-minute exclusive footage showcases one-eyed daitya, creatures, 'Hollywood-level VFX at par with The Lord of the Rings'- Report
entertainment.summary: The upcoming film 'Ramayana,' featuring Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, garnered positive attention after a 15-minute exclusive footage screening at the Big Cine Expo 2026 in Chennai. The footage highlighted a one-eyed daitya and various creatures, showcasing VFX described as "Hollywood-level" and comparable to that of 'The Lord of the Rings,' further increasing anticipation for the film's release.
